name: Desktop Grand Pack
description: Reduce Windows promotions and optional tracking. Review recommended app removals before applying.
author: ThisIsMyPC

entries.description: Limits optional Windows diagnostic data. Required diagnostic data can still be sent.
Stops Windows from recording which apps you start.
Stops apps from using your per-user Advertising ID to build a cross-app profile for targeted ads.
Stops Windows from collecting your local application activity history (Timeline/Activity Feed).
Blocks Windows Recall snapshots and AI analysis of your activity (three WindowsAI policies set together).
Stops Windows from suggesting Store apps to install in the Start menu.
Stops tip notifications and "Get the most out of Windows" prompts.
Stops the suggestion entries Windows injects into the Settings app and Start pane.
Stops the ad-like "suggested content" tiles in the Settings app (three ContentDeliveryManager values set together).
Removes tips, fun facts, and ads from the lock screen. Spotlight wallpapers keep working.
Stops promotions for OEM and preinstalled apps and the related feature tips.
Stops Windows from silently installing suggested Store apps onto the Start menu.
Stops Start Menu search from sending your queries to Bing; results stay local (may require an Explorer restart).
Disables the Windows Copilot assistant by policy in both machine and user scope (may require an Explorer restart).
Removes the Copilot button from the taskbar (may require an Explorer restart).
Removes Microsoft Edge's Hubs sidebar, including its Copilot rail. Takes effect the next time Edge restarts.
Removes the Widgets button and its news-and-interests feed from the taskbar.
